DATA_EXISTS_MAPPING_MISSING.meaning: Committed fixture data exists but has no matching database entry key; no religious data insertion is proposed by this audit.

DATA_DUPLICATE.meaning: Multiple fixture records resolve to the same import key; importer ON CONFLICT would collapse them, so they require source-level review before a database import.

DATA_CONFLICT.meaning: Fixture and database use the same key with another different locator or payload value; never update automatically.

DATA_EXISTS_NORMALIZATION_MISSING.meaning: Fixture and database agree on the record key but not its canonical category; preserve the raw source label and review the normalization mapping before any update.

DATA_EXISTS_WRONG_ASSOCIATION.meaning: Fixture and database agree on the record key but not its reader/rawi assertions; never auto-reassign a reading.

DATABASE_ONLY_REQUIRES_REVIEW.meaning: Database entry has no committed fixture counterpart; never delete automatically.
